outcome_values_inspected_before_freeze: none; only finite-row counts of model inputs and of the 24h target were read (coverage audit 2026-11-14T18:30:00Z), and no metric, coefficient, prediction, target distribution statistic, or contrast was computed
claim: The sealed FCLR-011 funding-conditioned volatility PASS (C2 vs B1, +4.94% relative QLIKE reduction, 5 instruments, 3 blocks, 2026-05..2026-08) does NOT produce the same direction/magnitude on three disjoint, never-tested 30-day Binance test blocks (2025-06, 2025-11, 2025-12). This is an EXPLORATORY transportability audit: it can yield EXPLORATORY_SIGNAL or EXPLORATORY_NULL, but it cannot promote H1 or claim confirmatory status while Gate 4 Binance v5 terms evidence remains unresolved.

why_this_is_new.problem_with_prior_period_tests: Every prior funding-conditioned volatility period test is either the sealed FCLR-011 window (2026-05..2026-08), the forward 2026-08..2026-10 confirmation (NOT_REPLICATED), the 2025-02..2025-05 cross (NOT_REPLICATED, rel 0.29%), the 2024-07-23..2024-09-30 cross (NOT_REPLICATED, rel -20.77%), the 2025-07-23..2025-10-15 cross (NOT_REPLICATED, rel -8.97%), or the 2026-01..2026-04 cross (NOT_REPLICATED, rel -0.89%). None of the three test months in this campaign has been used as a test block.
why_this_is_new.untested_window: The cached Binance archive holds complete hourly mark/premium/index klines and 8-hourly funding for the five FCLR-011 symbols. The three test months are disjoint from every prior tested window and fully materialized on disk: coverage audit 2026-11-14T18:30:00Z reports 5 symbols, 3 blocks, 3600 test rows per block, and train rows 2760/3432/3552.
why_this_is_new.not_a_relitigation: The sealed FCLR-011 artifact is not mutated or re-scored. This is a new period with identical models, metric, contrasts, and gate structure, so the null can be broken on genuinely fresh out-of-sample evidence.
why_this_is_new.no_label_use: No liquidation label is consumed. This arm is volatility-only.
why_this_is_new.separation: Test blocks are 2025-06-01..2025-06-30, 2025-11-01..2025-11-30, and 2025-12-01..2025-12-31. Each has a 30-day train window ending 7 days before test start. Train months may overlap earlier tested periods as legitimate pre-test history; only the test months must be disjoint from previously evaluated outcomes.
why_this_is_new.regime_note: 2024-06 is also reported feasible by scripts/next_campaign_status.py, but it is excluded here to keep a single 2025 regime and avoid the early-funding warm-up period.

splits.design: disjoint 30-day test blocks; each block refits on its own 30-day train window; 7-calendar-day embargo between train end and test start
splits.block_rule: Three non-overlapping test blocks, each preceded by a 7-day embargo. No padding, no imputation, and no test rows are dropped for missing inputs.
splits.train_span_note: Each block has its own 30-day train window. Train history may overlap prior tested periods; only test blocks must be disjoint.

gates.ci_method: day-block bootstrap over UTC days, pooled across blocks
gates.holm_family: all horizon x contrast x block cells
gates.loio_note: leave one instrument out of training, evaluate on the held-out instrument
gates.placebo_rule: permute signed_funding and abs_fund_pct within symbol; true relative reduction must exceed the null 95th percentile
gates.leakage_rule: every feature strictly causal at t; target strictly forward; 7-day embargo between train end and test start

verdict_rule.EXPLORATORY_SIGNAL: materiality_ge_2pct AND ci_excludes_zero_improving AND holm_pass AND loio_ge_4_of_5 AND placebo_pass AND leakage_audit_pass AND instruments_ge_5 AND blocks_ge_3
verdict_rule.EXPLORATORY_NULL: materiality FAIL or CI includes zero, with admissible data and leakage
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: instruments < 5 or blocks < 3 or leakage FAIL or no finite primary rows

status_rule.reason: Gate 4 Binance v5 terms evidence is unresolved; no confirmatory Binance outcome may be claimed.

forbidden: threshold shopping or feature changes after outcome inspection
reusing an inspected window as a fresh confirmation
declaring a CONFIRMED or PROMOTED status for H1_primary
treating the unresolved Binance v5 terms blocker as resolved
reusing an execution whose training span was empty (such a run is void, not evidence)

coverage_audit.note: Coverage + train feasibility only: finite-row counts and train-span arithmetic. No outcome statistic computed. Every block has 5 instruments and 3600 test rows.

universe.rule: the five FCLR-011 symbols, restricted to complete cached months with funding and the three never-tested 2025 test blocks
